title: The Tu--Deng circular-addition inequality
summary: Prove the uniform half-cube bound for low-weight pairs representing every nonzero residue modulo 2^k - 1.

formal_statement.body: Let $M=2^k-1$ and $1\le t<M$. Define $S(t,k)=\{(a,b)\in\{0,\ldots,M-1\}^2:a+b\equiv t\pmod M,\operatorname{wt}_k(a)+\operatorname{wt}_k(b)<k\}$. Prove $|S(t,k)|\le2^{k-1}$ for every $k\ge2$ and admissible $t$.

scope.domain: Circular addition, Boolean weights, and algebraic immunity
scope.unresolved_remainder: The Lean artifact completely proves the displayed inequality, but does not formalize the stronger equality characterization or the count of equality residues; priority and independence of competing proof claims also require a literature audit.
